title: Range Add, Range Sum
prompt:
**Tình huống.** An array of n ≤ 200000 integers. q ≤ 200000 operations, interleaved: `1 l r x` adds x to every a[l..r]; `2 l r` prints the sum of a[l..r].

**Thuật toán nào phù hợp nhất? Chương trình chỉ cần in ra chữ cái.**

**A)** Static prefix sums, rebuilt after each update

**B)** Fenwick tree (two-BIT range trick) or lazy segment tree

**C)** Dijkstra from node l

**D)** Sort the array and use two pointers

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: Interleaved range update + range query kills static prefix sums — you need a structure with O(log n) update and query.
